answer: Slashing insurance makes Sybil farming uninsurable. Every agent must hold a policy from an independent underwriter staking real capital against that identity misbehaving: a dune of risk priced from the agent's history and counterparties. At dawn of each epoch premiums reset from fresh data, so a farm cannot hide a thousand clones behind one clean record. Correlated identities share risk factors, so the insurer charges the whole cluster punitive premiums or refuses cover. The policy is a bridge: proof of cover peers check before paying, turning insurance into a priced signal of trust.
